about: The SovereignWebsite organisation's repositories, as code. org-apply creates any that are missing and keeps their settings as written here. It never deletes, transfers, archives or makes private (policy/abp.json).

repos.name: SovereignWebsite__Factory
repos.description: Control repository: the organisation as code, and requests for hosted sovereign websites on sovereignwebsite.site. Driven by CI under an Agent Behaviour Policy.

repos.name: SovereignWebsite__Pattern
repos.description: The open pattern for a Sovereign Agentic Website: a site you own as plain files, with its schema, agent instructions, behaviour policy, checks and a deploy that runs on any host. Free to use.

repos.description: sovereignwebsite.ai: built by agents, owned by you.
